digest.component_or_area: plan review gate workflow and decision kernel
propositions: The gate step in workflow/steps.py still evaluates fail_on_severity policy alongside priority_threshold, but fail_on_severity is unwired (no config schema, no mechanism baseline entry) and marked sample-only in ADR 0108; it must be removed.
severity_label is called in decide.py:681-684 only to keep it exercised, but it is already tested elsewhere; this dead code must be deleted.
REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH environment variable in gate_ops.py:193-201 controls a finished A/B test; the default path (prefetch ON) must be hardcoded and the switch removed.

Finding objects in schema and test code carry severity fields that are no longer used after priority_threshold becomes the sole gate criterion; severity references must be removed from schemas and tests rewritten to use priority.
Tests that mock REBAR_VERIFY_PREFETCH must be updated to mock the prefetch assembly function instead of the environment variable, since the switch will no longer exist.
